reviews.title: A great photo tracker
reviews.text: Easy to use and perfect for keeping track of things. It’s better than cluttering up your camera roll. I use it to keep track of progress with my car builds and renovations around the houses.
reviews.author: tomcworld

reviews.title: Keep track of my home projects
reviews.text: I plan to use it to keep track of my home projects that I never seem to finish. Hopefully this help me realize my goals.
reviews.author: Takeoutchick

reviews.title: So much fun
reviews.text: I’ve been using SnapLapse to track the progress of my scarf knitting project and it’s so cool to see the progress pics as a gif! Would recommend to any crafters out there!
reviews.author: Alice_Eru
